none: PAS CAM-6FB300: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy, possibly a contemporary copy, of a nummus of Constans, AD 337-350
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ [ ]-S P F AVG

A copper-alloy, possibly a contemporary copy, of a nummus of Constans, AD 337-350, (Reece period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, one standard. Mint is Trier, 340-341. See RIC VIII, p.145, c.f.106-7. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend reads [ ]-S P F AVG. Condition is fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.45g, diameter is 14.46mm.…
